description: Signed hash receipt (Merkle batch, RFC 9162) — Timestamped, signed receipt for up to 256 SHA-256 hashes in one call: an RFC 9162 Merkle root, a per-hash inclusion proof, and the hub's W3C VC + EIP-191 signatures over both. For agents that need third-party evidence of what they did and when (action logs, generated files, prompts, tool outputs) without sending the data itself. Pure code, no model; verify free at /api/v1/verify-provenance.

hashes.description: SHA-256 digests, 64 hex characters each. Hash your data locally; only the digests are sent.

label.description: Optional caller label (run id, job id) included in the signed receipt.

proofs.description: Return an inclusion proof per hash. Default true.

name: hash-receipt
